rationale: GPU audio compute only: the GpuCompute and shared-I/O provider WaveNet passes now compile one shared layer WGSL source with a storage-buffer stream state, the provider gains a WaveNet history reset and a diagnostic position readback, and a Dawn probe pins staged-storage-plus-timestamps completion.
